name: Explore district and ADM3 boundary layers
description: Verifies the geographic explorer loads the sourced Sierra Leone administrative polygons and identifies dataset provenance.
steps: Wait for the district and ADM3 layers to load
Review layer controls and source attribution
expected: The interactive map displays Sierra Leone district and ADM3 reference polygons, with layer toggles, source years and attribution visible.

name: Find and display Koya and East III
description: Verifies Koya and East III are selectable geographic features and highlighted from the source ADM3 layer without geometry edits.
steps: Search for Koya and select it under ADM3 areas
Confirm the Koya feature is highlighted
Search for East III and select it under ADM3 areas
expected: Koya and East III can both be selected and highlighted as ADM3 source features; their geometries are displayed unchanged.

name: Use the map on a mobile screen
description: Verifies map controls and source limitations remain readable on a narrow viewport.
steps: Open a constituency detail page on a mobile viewport
Use the map focus selector to choose East III
Review the geography note below the map
expected: The map controls stack vertically, East III can be selected, and the page states that ADM3 reference geometry is not a constituency boundary.

name: Automatically focus the parent district when opening a constituency
description: Verifies opening a constituency automatically frames its parent district in the enlarged map and preserves the administrative context without inventing constituency geometry.
steps: Open a district dashboard and choose one of its constituency entries
Review the map extent, selected district highlight and ADM3 overlay
expected: The map automatically zooms to fit the complete parent district within the enlarged map canvas, highlights the district, keeps ADM3 reference areas visible and labels the selected constituency without implying that a constituency boundary is available.
